title: The Last Hour | ECHO//100 Episode 19
description: Kavi must choose between restoring the timeline or saving the fragments of his lost history. As reality fractures, he faces a final integration with his greatest enemy. Episode 19 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: The sky above the wireframe shatters like glass, exposing terrifying voids behind the code.
scenes.caption: Reality begins to crack.
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses looking up at a sky fracturing into jagged geometric shards.

scenes.text: Byte flickers as the Missing Hour hemorrhages raw data into the physical world.
scenes.caption: The archive is leaking.
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating entity with orange antenna, glitching against a backdrop of crumbling city buildings.

scenes.text: Kavi possesses enough energy to reboot one moment, but only one memory holds truth.
scenes.caption: Kavi weighs his choices.
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi clutching his backpack, staring at a holographic map showing a single glowing time coordinate.

scenes.text: Mira’s blue projection screams while dissolving to anchor the unstable timeline bridge.
scenes.caption: Mira fades away.
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal coat turning into blue digital dust while floating above a wireframe abyss.

scenes.text: Null emerges from the shadows, his red eyes burning with a desperate, unexpected offer.
scenes.caption: Null steps forward.
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a glitchy black and purple figure, standing before Kavi on the edge of the void.

scenes.text: He offers to sacrifice his core, stabilizing the bridge at the cost of consciousness.
scenes.caption: A final sacrifice.
scenes.image_prompt: Null reaching out a glitching hand toward Kavi, his form slowly turning transparent and white.

scenes.text: Their codes collide, merging into a blinding flash that rewrites the fabric of existence.
scenes.caption: The two become one.
scenes.image_prompt: Bright light enveloping Kavi and Null, their silhouettes fusing into a single glowing figure.

scenes.text: Kavi remains, yet remembers everything Null did, and the war has only just begun.
scenes.caption: One soul, two memories.
scenes.image_prompt: A single Kavi standing alone, wearing his red hoodie, with one eye glowing intense, sinister red.
